title: Roveia three-step panel (v2)
description: A charcoal rounded panel (40px radius) with a full-bleed video slot behind: a 64px white heading on the left and three steps on the right, each a dotted 28px label, a 40px light title and a small grey line. Steps fade and rise in as they enter.
notes: the panel wraps itself in .dark; its colour is the theme's secondary (charcoal in Roveia)
the media slot fills the panel (object-fit: cover)
name: roveia-v2-steps

props.name: media
props.description: the video or picture behind the whole panel; a charcoal placeholder shows when empty
